Title: Old Jyhad player, I miss it. What is the current state of the game? (USA)

Messages.Author: Plantagenet
Messages.Body:
I am an old Jyhad player from the 1990s, attracted by the game play, the artwork and the rich fiction of the game. I stopped playing when I moved out of state and never found players to play with again... this was before they changed the name to V:TES.

I am interested to know what the current state of the game is, especially in the USA. A high quality and functional online version would be amazing, but I doubt that is a thing.

I am in the Oklahoma area, but travel often.

Messages.Author: ruiza97
Messages.Body:
We play about every other week in Dallas. One of our players Skype's in from Oklahoma.

There's a good online version using  LackeyCCG . It works very well and is update-to-date.

About the game, there have been a lot of expansions since Jyhad, so the game has changed a lot even though its core mechanics are still the same. If you watch an online game, you'll probably recognize some cards that were there since the beginning of the game.
